text: poll_until_ready in src/shim/lifecycle.rs caps at MAX_BACKOFF_ATTEMPTS=30 (500ms * 30 = 15s max) regardless of ENGRAM_READY_TIMEOUT_MS. Commands always fail after ~15s even when timeout is configured higher. Fix: replace attempt-count loop with deadline-based loop.

background_db_hydration in src/tools/lifecycle.rs calls hydrate_code_graph (loading 22MB+ JSONL) BEFORE set_hydration_ready() fires. On large workspaces this blocks Ready state for minutes. Fix: call set_hydration_ready() immediately, then run hydration in a lower-priority background task, or add a fast-path that does not block Ready.

CozoDB upsert calls in src/services/hydration.rs (upsert_node, upsert_function via run_script_busy_retry_mutable) are synchronous SQLite inside async fn, blocking the tokio runtime thread. This prevents IPC probe responses during hydration. Fix: wrap all CozoDB calls in spawn_blocking so the async executor remains responsive.

Daemon auto-indexing at startup causes OOM: indexing 1382 workspace files accumulates 14GB+ RAM (observed in process WorkingSet64). The daemon becomes unusable and host system is at risk. Fix: add memory limits/batching to the indexer, defer auto-index until after first tool call, or stream/discard processed file data.

After successful direct indexing (engram index --direct), workspace-status reports code_graph: {code_files: 0}. The count_code_files() query returns 0 even though data was written to the DB (size grew from 24MB to 29MB). Fix: audit count_code_files() query against the actual schema written by the indexer.

engram search/symbols/map-code/impact tools block with 'Indexing is in progress' during auto-index. There is no way to query existing indexed data while a background re-index runs. Fix: allow read-only tool calls against the current DB snapshot while indexing proceeds in background; only block writes/mutations during indexing.
